gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its small counters unclogged and friendly. Shantell Sans sits above it as a wide-mouthed, hand-drawn display face, its horizontals as stout as its verticals while the body stays slim and light.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarala: Wide-mouthed, expressive letters, all cut with one fixed nib width. Sarala stays modern and inviting line after line, its neon-tube strokes and distinct gaps never clogging beside Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text has open terminals that are simple to follow. Under Shantell Sans, whose rounds and stems all share one weight, it would carry a long passage in a plain sans manner, smooth and unfussy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Rope-like strokes, wide-mouthed and unmistakably expressive, lead. Under it, ZCOOL XiaoWei tapers gently like a sharpened pencil line, letting Shantell Sans be loud while the text stays modest.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, its tall body making ascenders look short. Over a longer stretch its tight spacing and well-separated curve endings keep the text moving, a quiet foil to Sniglet's stubby, level headings.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text brings open terminals that are easy to follow. Sniglet's stroke never changes width and its terminals stop short of curling, so the heading and the sans body share a plain, level manner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta-malar: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One stands tall with wide gaps between letters. Its sharpest trait is the gap in scale, since Mukta Malar, a sans-serif with compressed ascenders, stays modest beside the tall display lowercase.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yantramanav: Loud stencil punch, with wide bridges slicing through every Snowburst One letter. And Yantramanav, a modern sans with huddled letters and lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, gives that noise somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-outfit: Cut-out stencil attitude, with tall lowercase and wide gaps. Outfit lets its curves finish well before they close, like bent cable in sans-serif form, so Snowburst One's rowdiness feels tamed beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-display: Tube-bent bravado: Tilt Neon draws every stroke at a constant width, with a splayed c terminal adding swagger. Noto Sans Display keeps its sans-serif lowercase generous and approachable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-viga: Viga reads plain and unfussy, its capitals barely taller than their neighbors and not a hairline or shadow in sight. Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes make the heading loud and commanding.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bpmf-huninn: Round, loud and pen-drawn, Turret Road leads the way. Bpmf Huninn follows with a modern single-weight outline feel, and the wide channel into every bowl keeps paragraphs of it easy on the eye.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hanken-grotesk: Round, open-parenthesis forms in a pen-like line: Turret Road. Hanken Grotesk, a plain sans with a wire-bent look and wide channels into every counter, supplies all the restraint that bold heading lacks.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Big round curves and a steady pen line: that's Turret Road. The heading excels at constant, commanding strokes, while Noto Sans Cypriot does its best work keeping the e open and approachable.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-tomorrow: Neon-tube heft and round curves: Turret Road makes an entrance. That heading is made to command, while Tomorrow, its bowls opening like a cupped palm, is made to be read.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its tiny counters unclogged. Underdog draws bent-straw lines with no weight shift on any curve, which sets it far apart from that low sans-serif body.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cal-sans: Big-eyed lowercase and daylight in every curve: Unica One announces itself. Cal Sans takes over with its single stroke width and short ascenders, so the two hand the page off without any jostling.
